mapper.sql: p.id, p.user_id, p.board_type, p.title, p.analysis_id, p.concept_id, p.view_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.status AS author_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) AS comment_count

where.if: AND (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!')

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET view_count = view_count + 1, updated_at = updated_at WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT , p.content, a.user_id AS analysis_owner_id, COALESCE(a.is_public, FALSE) AS analysis_public, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users au WHERE au.id = a.user_id AND au.status = 'ACTIVE') AS analysis_owner_active, (a.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS analysis_deleted, a.title AS analysis_title, a.project_name AS analysis_project_name, cn.status AS concept_status, cn.name AS concept_name, cn.category AS concept_category, cn.difficulty AS concept_difficulty, cn.summary AS concept_summary FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN analyses a ON a.id = p.analysis_id LEFT JOIN concepts cn ON cn.id = p.concept_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, board_type, title, content, analysis_id, concept_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{boardType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{analysisId}, #{conceptId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM posts WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analyses WHERE id = #{analysisId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'DONE' AND is_public = TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM concepts WHERE id = #{conceptId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED')
